## Task 1 · The vault of the space station (2 marks)

The vault opens when (p ∨ q) ∧ ¬r, with p = "the player has the code card",
q = "the player is a captain" and r = "the station is in alarm mode".

a) The vault stays shut when ¬((p ∨ q) ∧ ¬r). Use De Morgan's laws to write
this without a NOT in front of brackets. (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

b) Simplify (p ∧ ¬r) ∨ (q ∧ ¬r), and name the law you use. (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

## Task 2 · The trap room (3 marks)

The designer writes: "The fire trap burns when the player steps on the
plate, unless the player wears the fire cloak. A player with low health
(less than 20) is pushed back instead, with or without the cloak."
Letters: p = steps on the plate, c = wears the cloak, h = health < 20.
Actions: **Push back**, **Burn**, **Nothing**.

a) Make the decision table with 8 rows and one action in each row. (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=6 >}}

b) Write the rules as an else-if chain in the right order. Then give two
edge-case tests for "health < 20" with the action for a player on the plate
without the cloak. (2 marks)

{{< answer-space lines=3 >}}
